method: Held-out spot-check. The prose rules were tuned on the Sleipner–Volve–Johan Sverdrup study area (quadrants 15–16) and then frozen. Every k-th extraction (ordered by key) from wellbores OUTSIDE that area was read against its source sentence. Verdicts: correct = a real drilling incident of the stated type, at the stated depth when one is given; depth_off = right incident, wrong depth; not_event = not an incident of this well. Precision only — incidents the extractor missed are not counted (recall is not measured). Labels are reproducible: the key is sha1(well|sentence)[:10].
